title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Aya Osawa has a crush on the masked clerk at her favorite record store, not knowing the clerk is her female classmate Mitsuki Koga. Bonding over rock music, their friendship slowly turns into romantic love.
life_message: A good life means being known and loved for who you really are.

content.note: Same-sex romance between high-school girls; no explicit content noted (Wikipedia; AniList Yuri 94%).
